_comment: Contracts needed from the iOS SDK Roblox was built against (CLAUDE.md
evidence source 3). tvOS headers do not declare these classes at all, so
the iOS SDK is the only authority on superclass, protocols and method
signatures -- which a shim has to match for isKindOfClass: and
UIHoverGestureRecognizer, even though the .tbd files export all six. The
list_dir targets establish whether those headers are in the SDK at all,
so a grep that finds nothing can be told apart from a declaration that is

targets.why: Is SFSafariViewController.h present in this SDK?
Cross-check: PDFDocument did resolve, so this directory should list it.
Cross-check against the two MF classes that did resolve.
Superclass, protocols and the initialisers Persona2 may use.
RobloxLib imports this class NON-weakly, so RobloxLib will not load without it. Its superclass must match or subclassing and isKindOfClass: break.
Confirm the superclass recorded by the bulk scan (UINavigationController).
Confirm NSObject <NSCopying> and the initialisers Persona2 uses.
Roblox's main binary needs WidgetCenter.shared and reloadAllTimelines; WidgetKit is absent on the device.
PushKit exists on the device but does not export _PKPushTypeVoIP; this records its declared type.
Present in iOS Foundation, absent from the device's; records its type.
CoreTelephony exists on the device but lacks this notification name.
Genuineness shim: the declared types of systemName, systemVersion, model and userInterfaceIdiom, so the shim returns exactly what iOS would.
Genuineness shim: the enum values, including which one iPad reports.
